top_findings.title: RDP exposed to the scan vantage
top_findings.evidence: Port 3389 open — RDP by convention (port-based, service not confirmed); a common brute-force / exploit target (e.g. BlueKeep class).
top_findings.recommendation: Restrict RDP to VPN/jump hosts; enforce NLA + MFA.

top_findings.title: Self-signed TLS certificate
top_findings.evidence: Certificate is self-signed (subject == issuer) — no trusted chain. JA4X=7022c563de38_7022c563de38_e73b053161df (for infrastructure correlation).
top_findings.recommendation: Use a CA-issued certificate for anything outside a closed lab.

top_findings.title: Windows RPC endpoint mapper enumerable (166 interfaces)
top_findings.evidence: The endpoint mapper answered an ept_lookup, disclosing 424 RPC endpoint(s) across 166 interface(s) (e.g. BFE.DLL, IKEEXT.DLL, MPSSVC.dll, SCardSvr.dll, appinfo.dll, appmgmts.dll, bthserv.dll, certprop.dll) — the internal RPC service map (services and their dynamic ports) an attacker uses to plan lateral movement.
top_findings.recommendation: Firewall port 135 and the dynamic RPC port range from untrusted networks; restrict RPC to management VLANs.

top_findings.title: OS identified: Windows 11 24H2
top_findings.evidence: OS identified as Windows 11 24H2 (confidence 0.97) by fusing 4 signal(s): build, smb2, hostname, family [method: smb2_ntlm_version+smb2+hostname].
top_findings.recommendation: Informational — asset inventory and patch-level tracking.
